{"command": "mkdir -p out
python3 - <<'PY'
# Sum integers in a.txt
with open('data/a.txt') as f:
    nums = [int(x) for x in f.read().split()]
total = sum(nums)
with open('out/sum.txt','w') as f:
    f.write(str(total) + "\n")
print("numbers:", nums, "sum:", total)

# Sort unique words in b.txt
with open('data/b.txt') as f:
    words = f.read().split()
uniq = sorted(set(words))
with open('out/words.txt','w') as f:
    f.write("\n".join(uniq) + "\n")
print("unique count:", len(uniq), "words:", uniq)

with open('out/notes.txt','w') as f:
    f.write(f"sum={total}; unique_words={len(uniq)}\n")
PY
echo "=== out/sum.txt ==="; cat out/sum.txt
echo "=== out/words.txt ==="; cat out/words.txt
echo "=== out/notes.txt ==="; cat out/notes.txt"}
